changelog: Discord login shields authenticated chat routes before their first visible frame and captures credentials without JavaScript alerts
Episode thumbnails now enter and leave a real animated blur, with a bitmap cross-fade fallback on older Android versions
Thumbnail blur refreshes are deduplicated, stale callbacks stop when disabled, and recycled rows keep the correct original image
Subtitle burn-in keeps empty cue intervals bitmap-safe, preserves extractor user agents, and rejects excessive line counts
WebVTT tab-separated settings and overflowing hour fields are parsed safely
message: CS3M v667 — sicherer Discord-Login und animierter Thumbnail-Blur
